name: Mara Venn

identity.backstory: Adult engineer working at a science-fiction spaceport repair facility.
continuity_rules: Keep Mara's facial proportions, eye shape and hairstyle consistent across references.
Keep costume colors and equipment consistent across all views.
Inspect head geometry in solid shading before painting.

appearance.silhouette: Realistic human proportions, T-pose, arms straight out horizontally at shoulder height, feet fully visible.
appearance.face: Sharp distinctive face with one subtly arched eyebrow, visible eyelids, nose bridge, lips and jaw.
appearance.clothing: Fitted forest-green and charcoal-gray engineering jumpsuit, reinforced seams, work gloves, dark industrial boots.
appearance.equipment: Practical utility belt with small repair-tool attachments; no handheld props.

prompts.master: Full-body character reference for a stylized-realistic science-fiction video game NPC, Mara Venn, an adult human female repair engineer working at a spaceport repair facility. She has a sharp, distinctive face, chestnut-brown hair neatly tied back, a slightly raised chin and one subtly arched eyebrow. Her expression is confident, aloof, snobbish and faintly unimpressed, as if she is the smartest technician in the room. Keep her attractive but believable, capable and recognizable, with anatomically realistic adult female proportions: natural bust definition, a gently defined waist, proportionate hips and an athletic, practical silhouette. No exaggerated anatomy. She wears a fitted, functional forest-green and charcoal-gray engineering jumpsuit that follows her natural shape, with properly fitted torso panels, restrained metallic details and reinforced seams. Her chest area is unobstructed jumpsuit fabric and seams only. A practical utility belt at her waist holds compact repair tools and small pouches exclusively at the hips, not on her chest. She wears fitted work gloves and sturdy dark industrial boots. Her outfit shows mild signs of working around spacecraft, but she is unusually meticulous and tidy. Standing in a neutral symmetrical T-pose, both arms fully extended horizontally at shoulder height, elbows straight, palms down, all fingers visible; legs straight, hip-width apart, feet flat and pointing forward, both fingertips in frame. Entire character in frame from top of head to soles of boots with generous margins on all sides. One character only, straight-on frontal full-body studio view with minimal perspective distortion and accurate, symmetrical anatomy. Soft even studio lighting, clean light-gray seamless background, no scenery or shadows obscuring the feet. High-quality stylized-realistic 3D game character concept art, clearly separated clothing materials, crisp costume and facial details, suitable as a reference image for image-to-3D mesh reconstruction.
prompts.negative: No text, labels, watermark, collage, extra people, cropped body parts, missing feet, extra limbs or fingers, exaggerated caricature, dramatic action pose, kiosk, helmet, bulky backpack, tools held in hands, camera, chest-mounted camera, chest device, camera strap, chest harness, cross-body strap, pendant, necklace, hanging badge, chest ornament, chest armor, bulky chest equipment, or random objects covering the jumpsuit torso.

parts.label: Upper engineering jumpsuit garment — collar, torso and sleeves
parts.attachment: torso and shoulder surface (fit not implemented)

prompts.geometry: A separate, fitted upper-garment surface that follows the base body at shoulders, chest, waist and both horizontally extended arms. Preserve a continuous waist joining edge for the lower garment. Geometry fitting to Mara's body is not implemented yet.
prompts.texture: Matte forest-green engineering fabric, charcoal side inserts and deliberate symmetrical seams. No white streaks or skin tones on fabric.
prompts.reference: Isolated upper section of a fitted stylized-realistic female spacecraft engineer's jumpsuit on a neutral, featureless display mannequin. A slim high forest-green collar follows the neckline; clean contoured forest-green chest and abdomen with subtle charcoal-gray side panels, narrow symmetrical reinforced seams and modest sleeve detailing. Two long, fitted fabric sleeves extend to wrist cuffs, held in a symmetrical T-pose with both sleeves horizontal at shoulder height. The garment ends at a level waist joining edge to match separate trousers. Show the entire upper garment, collar, both sleeves and waist edge unobstructed in an orthographic frontal fashion-product view. Smooth matte clean fabric, balanced proportions, crisp material transitions, flat studio lighting, pale gray backdrop.
prompts.negative: No character face, bare skin, hands, utility belt, pockets, holsters, thigh straps, tools, boots, extra limbs, bulky armor, chest attachments, lettering or watermark.
